_doc: Every LCSC part of one half. scripts/parts/import_lcsc.py --manifest hardware/parts.json builds hardware/parts/<LCSC>/; scripts/parts/bom_check.py checks stock. Quantities are per half. Fixups are in the footprint's own front-side coordinates (before the bottom-side flip) and cite their datasheet.

parts.role: Li-ion charger with power path (TI BQ24073RGTR)
USB D+/D- and VBUS ESD protection (ST USBLC6-2SC6)
Schottky diodes: USB VBUS and dock 5V into the charger input (B5819W)
TVS on the exposed dock 5V pad (SMF5.0A)
power slide switch between charger OUT and VDDH (MSK12C02)
reverse-mount RGB LEDs, common anode: status (GPIO) and charge (CHG/PGOOD) (MHT151RGBCT)

fixups.source: docs/datasheets/C409782_MHT151RGBCT.pdf p.2, 'Recommended Solder Pad (Reverse Type)': 0.8 x 0.7 mm pads, 2.3 mm between pad rows, 2.1 mm hole. EasyEDA's footprint has the pads 0.2 mm closer together and no hole.

parts.role: isolate the CHG and PGOOD GPIO reads from the charge LED's input-side supply (1N4148W)
5.1k: USB-C CC1, CC2; charger ILIM, ISET
1uF 50V 0603: charger IN (sees up to 26 V on overvoltage)
4.7uF 16V 0603: charger OUT, charger BAT, nRF VBUS
